$comment: Endpoints verified from cache osrs-241_2026-10-20 placements and climb actions; the Lady Lumbridge landing is from a revision 242 capture. The Wizards' Tower surface and basement are 6414 tiles apart, beyond the generic 6400-tile underground search. Each pair's up object offers Climb-up; down offers Climb-down.

pairs.name: Lady Lumbridge's hold ladder, Port Sarim (Dragon Slayer I capture 20261106T101002 tick 2917: down from 3049,3208,1 lands on 3048,9640,1 in the hold, 6432 tiles north)

Port Sarim Rat Pits manhole (the pit ladder is 56 tiles west of the manhole's underground square, outside the generic search; landings match the RuneLite shortest-path transports 3018,3231,0 -> 2962,9650,0 and 2962,9650,0 -> 3018,3233,0)
Forthos Ruin spiral staircase (landings match the shortest-path transports)

Kebos Lowlands spiral staircase (rsprox 1692 ticks 1007 and 1352: up from 1239,3684,0 lands on 3 tiles north, 1240,3687,1, where the search picks the climber's own column; down lands on 1240,3684,0 as the search does)

Civitas illa Fortis, Kualti underground staircase (rsprox 1098, a Leagues VI world: down from 1641,3164,0 and 1640,3164,0 both land on 1640,9567,0, ticks 27782 and 27932; up from 1641,9567,0 and 1640,9567,0 both on 1640,3164,0, ticks 27921 and 27991)

Keep Le Faye, ground to first floor (Merlin's Crystal capture MerlinsCrystal.bin, rev 242: up from 2770,3403,0 lands on 2769,3407,1 at tick 1029, down from 2769,3407,1 lands on 2769,3403,0 at tick 1252)
Keep Le Faye, first to second floor (MerlinsCrystal.bin: up from 2769,3397,1 lands on 2769,3401,2 at ticks 1039, 1104, 1159; down from 2770,3401,2 lands on 2769,3397,1 at ticks 1103, 1159, 1243)

Ardougne Castle main staircase (the upper flight is walled on its west, north and east sides, so it is only usable from the south; landings match the RuneLite shortest-path transports 2571,3298,0 <-> 2571,3294,1)

Braindeath Island brewery, north stairs (Rum Deal capture RumDeal.bin: down lands on 2151,5109,0 at tick 2986, the stairs' own west tile, where the search picks 2150,5109; up from 2150,5109,0 lands on 2153,5108,1 at 2998)

Paterdomus temple, north spiral staircase (rsprox local 1001683: down from 3416,3493,1 lands on 3417,3494,0 at tick 11337, the stairs' north side, where the search picks the climber's own tile; up is left to the search, which lands as captured)

Paterdomus temple, south spiral staircase (rsprox local 1001683 tick 11609 and 1001965 tick 18786: down from 3416,3484,1 lands on 3417,3483,0, the stairs' south side, where the search picks the climber's own tile; up is left to the search, which lands as captured)

Ruins of Tapoyauik entrance stairs (cache rev 242: surface 54525 offers Climb-down at 1693,3230,0 and the ruins 54526 offers Climb-up at 1693,9630,2 — the ruins' +6400 underground plane is at height z2, which the generic plane-0 underground search cannot see, so the pair is declared. Landings: down on 1692,9630,2 and up on 1692,3230,0, both verified walkable next to the destination stairs (clip 0x1008 / 0x10080); the north row of the ruins is walled (0x20100). Post-quest re-entry per the Wiki's entrance map pin; the pre-quest seal is the Heart of Darkness quest's)

messages.$comment: Game messages a climb sends as the player lands, by loc id (Rum Deal capture RumDeal.bin: every climb of the brewery's Wooden Stairs).
